co_visibility.background: mask=0, valid=0; valid unshared surfaces have mask=0, valid=1
co_visibility.direction: source pixel to other capture cameras at the same timestep
co_visibility.membership: bit i identifies the i-th ordered capture camera; source bit is always zero; editor excluded
co_visibility.rgb_encoding: sum of camera rgb8 codes in sRGB byte space; lossless PNG only; no tonemapping
co_visibility.surface: first geometric surface according to Sample.annotation_glass; no reflected or refracted visibility
co_visibility.visibility_test: in-frustum and symmetric tangent-plane agreement at the nearest target pixel center

display.co_visibility: Same-time first-surface camera membership; additive camera colors; source excluded. Exact masks distinguish valid unshared surfaces from background.
display.color: Original renderer-tone-mapped sRGB, lossless WebP. No exposure correction or crop.
display.depth: Turbo depth: warm near, cool far; log distance on a fixed 0–15 m scale, clamped beyond 15 m. Colorized from the 8-bit axial-depth preview (15/255 m increments); black is background. Numeric training depth is unchanged.
display.plans: Manifest metric envelope and floor levels; furniture footprint proxies. Camera arrows indicate direction, not frusta.
display.position: World position normalized by annotation AABB, clamped for display.

selection: All consecutive rooms retained; shortcuts chosen by structural feature coverage with stable seed ties.
